release: Each tab is now true to its name. Copy Review (COPY-001..004 — assistant boilerplate left in visible copy, unfilled authoring placeholders, AI-tell phrasing, uniform paragraph rhythm) runs ONLY in the Content & SEO tool. It already ran there by request; it ALSO ran in Site Audit, not by intent but by default, because the advisory pass with no explicit list runs all four. The result was a technical report carrying a copy section and the same finding surfacing in two tools, one of which nobody opens looking for copy problems. Site Audit now names its passes and keeps the ones that are technical: content artifacts (mojibake, unresolved tokens) and misspellings are SCORED functional defects folded into the functional suite — a mojibake is a bug, not a copy opinion — and Best Practices is web hygiene. NO SCORING CHANGE, and it is measured rather than argued from the weights table: the Copy Review suite carries weight 0 and every one of its rows is status manual, which the scorer skips in both the open-risk and total-risk paths, and the suite now proves it from the other direction by taking the app own shipped result, adding a copy suite BACK, recomputing, and asserting the number is identical. A Site Audit score from 5.1.0 is directly comparable to one from 5.2.0. A Site Audit report no longer contains a copy suite and no longer declares COPY-* rules as evaluated in its coverage ledger — a rule is declared if and only if it ran, and that is asserted in both directions so it cannot be satisfied by declaring everything or nothing.
